notes: The first-cut local removable-media fallback keeps attach and mount authority on the host.
The disposable ingest jail receives a read-only mounted tree at /ingest and scratch space at /work.
No raw block device nodes are exposed inside the ingest jail in this first implementation floor.
The canonical admitted example family is fstyp=exfat; the first allowlist remains finite rather than inheriting every host-visible filesystem helper.
The mounted /ingest tree stays inert input only; it is not a direct execution or document-open source.

Mount hardening for this lane is ro/nosuid/noexec/nosymfollow/untrusted and the lane fails closed if that tuple cannot be realized. Device-node denial is enforced separately by devfs/no-raw-device posture plus regular-file-only capture, not by a FreeBSD nodev mount flag.
The ingest walk for this lane stays physical and root-pinned beneath /ingest, admits only regular files plus explicit directories, and fails closed on symlink/device/FIFO/socket semantics.
Hardlink topology is not preserved in the first cut; the lane stays content-import-shaped rather than filesystem-fidelity-shaped.
Member paths in this lane normalize to relative-clean Unicode NFC text, normalization collisions fail closed, and there is no silent auto-rename or source-prefix repair.
Reviewed/import identity in this lane stays path/kind/payload-first; owner/mode/mtime/xattr fidelity out of scope and any receiver-local metadata outcomes are receiver-local realization detail.
